_meta._note: Chapter 22 review (ch22-l05, REVIEW; display order 6 after the new ch22-cl09; file renamed chapter-22-lesson-06-review.json because fixtures map to rows by display order). Fresh mini-dialogues (Fatimah asks where the mosque is; Ahmad answers; a teacher checks understanding) interleave speaker identification, question versus statement, answer relevance, and understanding / repair choices; 12:36, 3:37 and 2:186 are recalled only. No new morphology or Quran assertion; the 109:1 قُلْ hook is gone. Reveal قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا (12:36, indices 4–5). Rebuilt 2026-09-24 from Docs/proposals/chapter-22-content-proposal.md with the owner-approved review amendments recorded there (Ali 'Imran 3:37 as the verified ayah in which قَالَ reports a question and قَالَتْ its answer; Al-Baqarah 2:186 سَأَلَكَ as a real سَأَلَ in the Quran; Yusuf 12:90 as the second verified speech frame; CL5's heard-only هَلْ فَهِمْتُمْ؟ / مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ promoted to spoken lines rather than treated as new). The map and fixtures named two reader_lecture_22 files that never existed in the repository, so the proposal is recorded as the source.

noor_intro.en: Review time. For every line ask: who spoke, was it a question, and did the answer fit?
noor_intro.ur: جائزے کا وقت۔ ہر سطر کے لیے پوچھیں: کون بولا، کیا یہ سوال تھا، اور کیا جواب مناسب تھا؟

explanation.en: قَالَ reports any speech, a question included. سَأَلَ reports asking. أَجَابَ reports answering.
explanation.ur: قَالَ کوئی بھی بات بیان کرتا ہے، سوال بھی۔ سَأَلَ پوچھنا بیان کرتا ہے۔ أَجَابَ جواب دینا بیان کرتا ہے۔

explanation.en: The speaker follows the verb; inside the quotation, I and my mean that speaker.
explanation.ur: بولنے والا فعل کے بعد آتا ہے؛ اقتباس کے اندر 'میں' اور 'میرا' اسی بولنے والے کے ہیں۔

concept.ar: قَالَ يَا مَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَا

explanation.en: A question can be reported with قَالَ (3:37). Look at the words, not the verb.
explanation.ur: سوال قَالَ سے بیان ہو سکتا ہے (3:37)۔ فعل نہیں، الفاظ دیکھیں۔

explanation.en: أَيْنَ: a place. مَا: a thing. مَنْ: a person. هَلْ: yes or no, from the facts.
explanation.ur: أَيْنَ: جگہ۔ مَا: چیز۔ مَنْ: شخص۔ هَلْ: ہاں یا نہیں، حقیقت کے مطابق۔

explanation.en: Understood: confirm with the fixed reply. Not understood: ask politely for it again.

noor_explanation.en: قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: one of them said. Speaker, words, question, fitting answer, understanding: you can now follow a short exchange from start to finish.
